$comment: Auto-update is OFF. Turn it on only after reading watcher/autoupdate.py's header. Each rule names one kind of line the watcher may replace: files matching glob, keys listed, new value between min and max, no single change larger than max_abs_change, evidence only from the listed hosts. Anything not matched by a rule cannot be changed automatically. OH JEDD/JEDZ files are deliberately absent: their entries carry rateSourceRaw, which a one-line edit would leave stale.
